mapper.select: select auth_id, user_id, customer_id, auth_type, auth_key, auth_secret, unionid, mobile, status from hm_user_auth where auth_type = #{param1} and auth_key = #{param2} and status = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into hm_user_auth(customer_id, user_id, auth_type, auth_key, auth_secret, unionid, mobile, status, create_time) values(#{customerId}, #{userId}, #{authType}, #{authKey}, #{authSecret}, #{unionid}, #{mobile}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: update hm_user_auth set customer_id = #{customerId}, user_id = #{userId}, auth_secret = #{authSecret}, unionid = #{unionid}, mobile = #{mobile}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where auth_id = #{authId}
mapper.select: select customer_id, user_id, mobile, nickname, avatar, gender, real_name, status, source_channel, org_id, last_login_ip, last_login_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from hm_customer_user where customer_id = #{customerId}

select address_id, customer_id, contact_name, contact_mobile, province_code, province_name, city_code, city_name, district_code, district_name, detail_address, longitude, latitude, is_default, create_time, update_time from hm_customer_address where customer_id = #{customerId} order by is_default desc, address_id desc

select address_id, customer_id, contact_name, contact_mobile, province_code, province_name, city_code, city_name, district_code, district_name, detail_address, longitude, latitude, is_default, create_time, update_time from hm_customer_address where address_id = #{addressId}
mapper.insert: insert into hm_customer_address( customer_id, contact_name, contact_mobile, province_code, province_name, city_code, city_name, district_code, district_name, detail_address, longitude, latitude, is_default, create_time ) values ( #{customerId}, #{contactName}, #{contactMobile}, #{provinceCode}, #{provinceName}, #{cityCode}, #{cityName}, #{districtCode}, #{districtName}, #{detailAddress}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{isDefault}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: update hm_customer_address set contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_mobile = #{contactMobile}, province_code = #{provinceCode}, province_name = #{provinceName}, city_code = #{cityCode}, city_name = #{cityName}, district_code = #{districtCode}, district_name = #{districtName}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, is_default = #{isDefault}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where address_id = #{addressId}
update hm_customer_address set is_default = '0', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where customer_id = #{customerId}
